firstLift.note: cmskiarea.com WP posts 12-13 Jan 2024: "BE CLOSED Saturday Jan 13th... Going to Try to be Open Sunday and Monday Jan 14th and 15th with limited operating hours and runs." A remarkably late start after "still currently closed" (9 Dec) and "Waiting for Cold" (28 Dec). This hill posts its changes, including the 13 Jan cancellation, and no further slip was posted; 18 Jan and 1 Feb posts confirm operation.
